arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM main.Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.ALP >= 300
  )
LIMIT 1
